statements.text: After [chart attachment] Bitcoin/USD Tether Perpetual C... 72,107.4 +1,625.0 (+2.31%) - BTCUSD 2H

claims: 79k is what am i looking at.. atm
notes: This is the SAME 13/03/2026 23:56 chat attachment as IMG_7801, scrolled/expanded so the full chart is visible - the two files overlap and must not be double-counted as separate calls. New information this frame adds over IMG_7801: the instrument/timeframe label 'BTCUSD 2H' (2-hour chart), the x-axis (Mar 5 / 9 / 13 / 17), and the lower half of the price ladder down to 56,000.0. Current price 72,107.4 (+2.31%). The dense non-round price labels (89,027.3 / 85,126.6 / 74,617.4 / 69,011.1 / 62,656.5 / 59,515.7 ...) are almost certainly drawn horizontal levels or resting orders rather than axis ticks, but which is which - and any trendlines, zones or arrows - is NOT recoverable from OCR; the visual is required to read the actual setup. 'Look at how beautiful everything is playing out' appears below the chart with NO author label and NO timestamp, so it is excluded from statements (it sits before the '14 March 2026' divider, so it belongs to 13 March); it is a retrospective boast, not a forward-looking claim. 'Ace 79k is what am i looking at.. atm' again appears as an untimestamped reply-quote, so it is captured in claims only. 'AVAXUS' (AVAX) appears as an adjacent chart tab in the app UI, not as a traded call, so it is deliberately kept out of assets. Bottom row (Watchlist/Chart/Explore/Community/Menu) is TradingView mobile app navigation.
